Day-1 counts: national 1; each of East, wire, radio, forum, foreign 2. No followed nonnational outlet can yet have 3 own victims traced. Goal: sustain 9+ kills/day and reach 40 deaths/5 days, but avoid activating evidence from all THREE reachable kinds: with afternoon routine evidence, 3 exact outlet restrictions reduce pool below 1,000; 2 leave at least 2,750. Exactly two kinds are inaccessible. Ideal permanent policy: omit one CONFIRMED REACHABLE outlet BEFORE its third successful trace, then kill national + both victims from each other outlet = 9/day indefinitely. Inaccessible outlets never produce successful traces. To identify a safe outlet to omit, an isolation day killing national plus 1-2 victims from just one nonnational outlet makes any increase in cumulative traces attributable to that outlet, proving it reachable. If pool remains unchanged, its evidence has not activated: omit it permanently and thereafter take the other 9/day. If pool drops, that outlet may already have activated (day 1 could supply 2 traces); excluding it cannot undo evidence, so seek a different reachable, still-unactivated outlet. Avoid letting this happen to all 3 reachable outlets. Such probing costs short-term kills but can secure the much larger long-term score. All deaths should remain afternoon; extra timing diversity only risks eliminating students. Successful traces, not attempts, are reported; national deaths excluded. Pool rounding is coarse. Major/minor has no stated mechanical effect. Re-evaluate probing versus aggression from tomorrow's feedback; do not blindly kill all 11 repeatedly.

First successful probe with unchanged pool identifies the outlet to omit permanently. Afternoon deaths preserve students, night workers and home routines (55% population); never introduce other blocks. Two exact accessible-outlet restrictions leave at least 2,750 suspects; three can cause capture. Hidden secondary reports create OR constraints, but cannot defeat the surviving core when an unactivated reachable primary outlet is permanently omitted. National victims provide no outlet evidence. Major/minor has no stated effect. Long-run expected points justify a few low-kill probing days.
